pages.title: Antiproton Decelerator
pages.text: A ring that catches antiprotons from collisions at nearly light speed and brakes them, lap after lap, until they can be trapped.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Turns antimatter pellets and virtual quarks into $(item)Antiproton Bundles$(), and bundles into $(fluid)Antihydrogen$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Antihelium Nucleus, Antihydrogen, Antihydrogen Crystal, Antiproton Bundle.
A few billion antiprotons, slowed from near light speed and held in a magnetic bottle.$(br2)Made in $(item)Antiproton Decelerator$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Antiproton Bundle$(): Antihelium Nucleus, Antihydrogen, Antihydrogen Crystal, Liquid Antihelium, Mirror Matter Foundry
$(fluid)Antihydrogen$(). Made in $(item)Antiproton Decelerator$().$(br)Used for: Baryogenesis Seed, Distillate of Forces, Liquid Antihelium.
